row.evidence: Jobber's pricing page (Core $29/mo billed annually, 1 user, add users for $29/mo each) and its help-centre team-management and security articles mention no SSO, SAML or SCIM; team members are added and deactivated manually under Manage Team.
row.notes: Status unchanged (none). Prices unchanged: Core $29/mo billed annually ($39/mo with a 1-year commitment billed monthly, $49/mo with no commitment); Connect $99/mo, Grow $149/mo, Plus $399/mo billed annually; extra users $29/mo each. June's note that OneLogin provides SAML SSO and provisioning for Jobber has no first-party source and is dropped. Jobber is not in the Okta Integration Network. Team members are invited by name and email and deactivated by hand, and a deactivated user frees a seat. The pricing page mentions Jobber's 'Open API' (an API tour on the Plus plan), but developer.getjobber.com returned HTTP 403 to every fetch, so no user API was verified. Confidence is medium on a none-by-absence basis: pricing page, help-centre Account and Settings topics, and the security and team articles were checked; the developer portal could not be loaded.

scim.notes: No SCIM, SAML or SSO is mentioned on the pricing page or in the help-centre security and team-management articles.

user_api.notes: The pricing page refers to 'Jobber's Open API'; the developer portal (developer.getjobber.com) returned HTTP 403 to curl, the headless renderer and WebFetch, so no user endpoints were verified.

onelogin.notes: June claimed a OneLogin SSO and provisioning connector; OneLogin pages block bots and Jobber has no OneLogin guide, so it is left unverified.

fallbacks.notes: Users are added manually (Gear icon > Manage Team > Add User) and deactivated manually; deactivating frees a seat. docs_public is false because the developer portal could not be loaded publicly (HTTP 403).
